name: Parcels
author: spacewaffle42
description: Parcels on their way: arrives today, out for delivery, delivered.

fields.name: parcel_1
fields.label: Parcel 1
fields.note: A tracking number, or the whole tracking link from the courier's email or text, then a nickname: JD0002240145 New boots

fields.name: parcel_2
fields.label: Parcel 2
fields.note: A comma between them if the number has spaces in it: AB 1234 5678 9GB, Printer ink

fields.name: parcel_4
fields.label: Parcel 4
fields.note: Empty a box once its parcel has come (delivered ones leave the panel by themselves).

fields.name: ship24_key
fields.label: Ship24 key
fields.note: Free from ship24.com: choose the free Tracking API plan, then Developers > API keys. Covers every courier.

fields.name: dhl_key
fields.label: DHL key (optional)
fields.note: Free from developer.dhl.com (Shipment Tracking - Unified). DHL parcels then don't use Ship24's 10.

fields.name: ups_client_id
fields.label: UPS client ID (optional)
fields.note: Free from developer.ups.com: an app with the Tracking API. UPS parcels then don't use Ship24's 10.

fields.name: every
fields.label: Check every (minutes)
fields.note: Checking a parcel it already follows costs nothing. DHL parcels are checked less often if needed, to stay in DHL's free 250 a day.

settings.note: Ship24's free plan follows 10 new parcels a month; a parcel past that waits until the 1st, and nothing is ever paid for. Only the tracking number is sent: a pasted link is read on the Matrix. Pop-ups never come in the sleep hours: they wait until the hours end, and are dropped if they're no longer news.
